hypothesis.statement: Separate G1 garment objects preserve modular intent but do not establish production clothing without patterned topology, PBR assets, Chaos Cloth, runtime swapping and deformation evidence.
hypothesis.action: Require four outfit slots, five production asset classes, PBR channels, body-independent swapping, two or more LODs, fourteen runtime checks and sixteen Looking Glass Go captures.
hypothesis.expectedResult: Complete fixture evidence passes while the procedural v79 jacket and footwear remain explicitly non-production.

decision: Preserve v79 object separation as architecture evidence only. Replace the procedural jacket and footwear before production registration.
nextEvidence: MetaHuman-fitted modular skeletal garment assets, Chaos Cloth bindings, slot manifest, zero-penetration runtime report and sixteen immutable Go captures
